eis_specs.document_title: Ararat Wind Farm — MP-permit source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Elmhurst switchyard, connecting to Ballarat-Horsham 220 kV line
eis_specs.notes: Regime: MP-permit. Planning permit submitted Jan 2010, approved Oct 2010 by Vic Planning Minister; grid route/substation permit granted 2012. Developer RES; consortium ownership: OPTrust/GE/RES/downer. Commissioned Jun 2017; 25-yr PPA with ACT Government. Capacity factor 27.49% (2018-2021 avg); annual net 578 GWh.
